evidence_items.publisher: Reuters (via Yahoo Finance), citing The Information

receipt.public_excerpt: Contracts ​involving Anthropic and ‌OpenAI now account for more than half of the $2 trillion in backlogs at major cloud providers

evidence_items.explanation: Three weeks before the post, reporting put the two companies' share at more than half of major cloud backlogs. That meets the 50% figure.

metric_scope.company: Major hyperscalers (Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Oracle); backlog owed by OpenAI and Anthropic
metric_scope.metric: share of contracted revenue backlog (remaining performance obligations)

evidence_items.publisher: ValueAdd VC (citing Jefferies via The Register)

receipt.public_excerpt: roughly half of the $2.3 trillion in contracted AI infrastructure backlog at Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon and Oracle is owed by just two customers, OpenAI and Anthropic

evidence_items.explanation: A later, independent analyst estimate also puts the share at about half, which corroborates the May reporting. It is dated after the target period, so it is context only.

receipt.public_excerpt: First quarterly operating profit in the periods presented (Q1 2025 to Q2 2026): $974m in Q2 2026, 8.4% margin

evidence_items.explanation: Anthropic reported a GAAP operating profit in Q2 2026. That cuts against 'no path to profitability', though the speaker's own exceptions keep this from being decisive.

unresolved_gaps: No hyperscaler disclosed a combined OpenAI plus Anthropic share; the figure is a press and analyst estimate.
Whether the two companies can pay their commitments without outside money is a question about the future, not settled by evidence at the post date.
